mapper.insert: insert into posts (title, content, user_id, tags, status) values (#{title}, #{content}, #{userId}, #{tags}, 1)
mapper.select: select id, title, content, tags, like_count, favorite_count from posts where status = 1 order by created_at desc limit #{limit} offset #{offset}

select id, title, content, tags, like_count, favorite_count from posts where status = 1 and (lower(coalesce(title, '')) like #{likeKeyword} or lower(coalesce(content, '')) like #{likeKeyword} or lower(coalesce(tags, '')) like #{likeKeyword})
order by created_at desc limit #{limit} offset #{offset}

select id, title, content, tags, like_count, favorite_count from posts where status = 1
order by view_count * 1 + like_count * 3 + favorite_count * 5 + comment_count * 4 desc limit #{limit}
select user_id from posts where id = #{postId} and status = 1
select id, title, content, tags, view_count, like_count, favorite_count, comment_count from posts where id = #{id} and status = 1
